CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-mix FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME (--mix | --no-mix) --dry-run [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.architecture: One private immutable LightingMoodMixPlan owns the existing path selection, ordered validation and LightingMoodMixEdit report. ConfigEditor::preview_lighting_mood_mix(&self, selector, mood_ref, enabled) and the existing writer use the same plan. No XML clone, writer-then-discard, diff simulation or generic mutation framework.
CLI_policy.admission: Exactly LightController2, exactly one direct LightscenesC and one direct mood matching exact stored SID or case-sensitive Name. Selected explicit signed32 SID1..31; CID must be nonnegative signed32 outside12..19 or omitted effective0. Every direct sibling SID must be explicit signed32, and selected numeric SID must be unique including equivalent spellings. MixMod must be ASCII true/false case variants or omitted effective/default false. Every existing guard and error stays unchanged, even on requested no-op.
CLI_policy.report: JSON adds dry_run=true and optional trace_id to the unchanged writer edit report. mood preserves raw UUID/SID/CID, cid_effective stays separate, before/after preserve actual raw MixMod storage, before_effective is the current boolean and enabled is proposed effective boolean. Missing MixMod remains null on false no-op; case variants and numeric identity spellings are not normalized. Changed requests still plan the existing lowercase true/false write only.
CLI_policy.formats: Boolean-specific table/CSV retain selected raw identity, raw/effective CID, raw before/after flags, effective before/after booleans, default and changed. CSV presence fields distinguish omission from empty. Quiet suppresses only the table summary; no-header suppresses headers, never preview rows. Normal writer output and its CSV column order are unchanged.
CLI_policy.read_only: Only this existing mutation is newly admitted to global --dry-run. CLI returns before mutation or save with no source/destination/default/stamp/directory/cache/telemetry writes, including input/existing/new save-as destinations, no-op and failures. Destination writability and writer serialization are not predicted.
CLI_policy.preservation: Existing writer signature, report, selection order, admission, lowercase-on-change/no-op preservation, save-as and stamp behavior are unchanged. No CID/MixMod default repair, sibling/cohort change, role/visibility inference, graph/reference edit, ID/range extension or unrelated Name/SName/SkipNext/icon/Qn/color/metadata normalization.
CLI_policy.failure: Unsupported or ambiguous needed identity, flag and selection data returns the identical writer diagnostic, never empty success. Unneeded opaque Num/LSConfig/output storage keeps existing admission. Other unplanned mutations still fail closed.
